The tartar removal was done in a very rushed way, in just over 10 minutes. I didn't even feel like my teeth were clean. Since I've had tartar removed 1-2 times a year, it's never taken less than 30 minutes. The next day, my tooth cracked while chewing bread, which wasn't hard at all. When the clinic called for a dentist to check it, they said it wasn't his fault, that it "cracked for some unknown reason." That's it. I went there because someone recommended it. I won't dare come back again, and I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.

The dentist spoke terribly. She said there was nothing she could do about my teeth and insulted me in various ways. I left the room crying. I've never encountered a dentist who spoke so badly before. After that, I went to another dentist, and I developed panic attacks, something I'd never experienced before. I was afraid to go to the dentist. It's been two years, and I still have these panic attacks and am extremely afraid of dentists.

I inquired about the cost of teeth scaling and was quoted 900-1200 baht. After they covered me with a cloth, the dentist said there wasn't much tartar, but the staff insisted on 1200 baht. They also pushed a fluoride treatment for another 500 baht. Afterward, they charged an additional 100 baht for opening my medical history. I've never encountered anything like this before.
The dentist was very gentle and gave excellent advice on dental care. This was my first time getting a teeth cleaning at this branch, and I was very impressed.

The dentist was a bit too heavy-handed; they rushed the tartar removal process and weren't thorough enough. I didn't even rinse properly afterwards. They just wanted to finish too quickly, without being thorough.

We didn't get our braces done here, but we wanted the clinic to cut the wire because it was poking our mouth. However, the counter staff, a chubby woman, was very rude. We had been there once before and a different staff member did it, and they charged us for that.
